regions.today: Staying dry and sunny today. Very warm for many with highest temperatures of 22 to 24 degrees, though a little cooler near the east coast in moderate easterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and mostly clear, with lowest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees, in light to moderate easterly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry and mostly sunny. Highest temperatures of 21 to 25 degrees, coolest near the east coast in moderate easterly winds.
